messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Implemented deal naming and the snapshot import fixes.

- Added a **Deal name** field that preserves spaces, enforces the 40 character limit, and stays with the current game. New games, restarts, board loads, and reloads clear it. [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx:41)
- Named exports use snapshot v2; imports restore v2 names and accept v1 saves. Snapshot fields can appear in any order while unknown fields remain rejected. [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts:16)

**Checks:** Typecheck passed; all 142 unit tests passed; all 78 browser journeys passed, and the updated snapshot journeys passed 3/3. Changed files pass the scoped formatting check. The repository-wide format check still flags 23 untouched files.
